subject: Next steps: vendor onboarding checklist & security artifacts
messages:
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@outertech.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: onboarding@outertech.com
Date: 2028-09-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Onboarding: security docs and PO flow

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the welcome call earlier. Procurement asked me to follow up with the artifacts you need to complete vendor activation. Can you confirm the exact items Redwood requires so we can prepare a single bundle? Our standard asks are: DPA signature, SOC 2 report, subprocessor list, and PO instructions.

Quick Qs:
- Do you need our full SOC 2 PDF or will a share link to the auditor's report suffice?
- Is there a preferred PO template or payment terms we should expect?

I'll start gathering items once I have your checklist and the PO routing details.

Thanks,
Asha Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
OuterTech Inc.
Attachment: outertech_company_profile.pdf (pdf)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@outertech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-09-05T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: security docs and PO flow

Hi Asha — great to meet you on the call. Appreciate you following up. Below is the checklist that will get your account fully activated in our procurement system: 

Required for activation (procurement & security gate):
- Signed DPA (we can accept OuterTech's DPA or use Redwood's template; please send whichever you prefer)
- SOC 2 report (either the full PDF or a secure link to the auditor portal is fine; a link is preferred for large files)
- Current subprocessor list (CSV preferred; include version/date)
- PO (we attach our PO template if helpful)

Additional, sometimes-requested artifacts:
- Data flow diagram (if available)
- Contact for SOC 2 questions (auditor contact)

PO routing & payment terms:
- Please send the PO to procurement@redwood.com and cc orders@redwood.com
- Standard net-30 is typical; if your terms differ, include them on the PO and we'll route to finance for approval
- Attach invoices to the PO thread to avoid hold-ups

I attached our PO template and a short onboarding checklist for your team to fill out. Once you send the DPA + subprocessor list we'll route to Security for validation (cc'd: Rishi) and to Legal if any redlines show up. Marissa will confirm final PO routing once Security signs off.

Thanks — happy to take a single zip with everything or individual items, whatever's easiest.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Vendor Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_po_template.xlsx (xlsx), redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf (pdf)
From: Asha Patel <asha.patel@outertech.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: onboarding@outertech.com
Date: 2028-09-06T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding: security docs and PO flow

Neha — thanks, attaching what we have.

Attached:
- OuterTech_DPA_draft_v2.pdf (pdf) — our legal team prepared this; we can sign but please flag any provisions you expect to change.
- subprocessors_list_2028-08.csv (csv) — exported from our vendor registry (version: 2028-08-14)
- OuterTech_SOC2-Link.txt — link to secure auditor portal (expires 10/15)
- initial_invoice.pdf (pdf) — placeholder invoice for reference

Notes:
- Our finance team prefers 45-day terms. If that requires approval, please tell us who to loop in.
- For the DPA: we included a clause about limited subprocessor chaining — please confirm Redwood's stance.

If you want, I can also send a zipped archive with everything to procurement@redwood.com.

Best regards,
Asha
Attachment: OuterTech_DPA_draft_v2.pdf, subprocessors_list_2028-08.csv, OuterTech_SOC2-Link.txt, initial_invoice.pdf
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Patel <asha.patel@outertech.com>
Date: 2028-09-07T15:44:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Onboarding: security docs and PO flow — OuterTech bundle

Marissa / Rishi — forwarding OuterTech's bundle for action. Key points below.

On Sep 6, Asha sent: OuterTech_DPA_draft_v2.pdf, subprocessors_list_2028-08.csv, and a SOC2 link.

My read / ask: 
- Legal: the DPA looks standard but includes a subprocessor-chaining clause that may need a minor edit. Rishi, can you confirm whether Security is comfortable with the listed subprocessors and the chaining language? Please escalate to Legal if needed — I put Marissa on copy for PO timing.
- Procurement/Finance: OuterTech is requesting net-45. Marissa, can you advise whether we can accept net-45 for initial pilot or should we push for net-30 and a one-time exception route? If we need approval, please outline approvers and estimated timeline.

Suggested next steps: 
1) Rishi: quick subprocessor review and DPA redline recommendations (EOD 9/08 if possible)
2) Marissa: confirm PO routing & whether finance will accept net-45 or require escalation (EOD 9/08)
3) If both thumbs up, Neha will confirm acceptance and send routing details to Asha for PO issuance.

Thanks — copying Asha so she has our internal notes.

Neha Kapoor
Vendor Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
